verdict.rationale: Adyen documents registrable webhooks that push asynchronous payment status changes to your server, so you don't have to poll. It also documents a Customer Area log of all webhook events sent to your server, and webhooks can be listed, fetched and tested through the Management API tools. However, the pack has no evidence for signed deliveries, automatic retry behavior or event replay, which are three of the story's five core elements. missing for 10: HMAC/signature verification of webhook payloads, documented automatic retry policy, replay/resend of past events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
